display_note: The shop_name, title_facts, shop_line, fits and shape fields were added by session 66f2548a for reader-facing copy only. Every fact used in shop_line and fits appears in that product's own observed_title, and title_facts lists those words so the derivation can be checked. No specification was taken from a review site, a search snippet or inference. These fields are display copy; they are not verified spec values, and the verified spec record stays in the observed_* fields and in data/register/products.json. outbound_status_reader was added in the same pass: it is the reader-facing wording of outbound_status for product cards. The audit wording is unchanged and is still shown verbatim on the shop table and the product pages. One comparative claim was withdrawn in this pass: an earlier draft described P03 as having "the highest Hi-Fry temperature of the three here", which cannot be supported, because P01's listing states a Hi-Fry option and no temperature. Ranking two products on a value that is only stated for one of them is exactly the inference this register exists to prevent.
